notes: Competition: 2-stage, realisation competition (UMWD seat incl. Regional Assembly hall), site at Mazowiecka / Wybrzeże Słowackiego by Grunwaldzki Bridge; budget cap 150 M PLN net.
Stage II deliverables: max 6 boards 100×70 landscape, white background, min. 8 visualisations (2 on supplied aerial photos), plans 1:200, façade section 1:50, white model 1:250.
Criteria (equal weight): function/programme efficiency · urban & architectural fit · attractiveness/originality · eco & energy (zero-emission 2027) · accessibility; secondary: cost realism.
Height: up to 45 m allowed only in the elevated zone A of the zoning plan; Regional Assembly (Sejmik) rooms recommended on top floors; rebuild the historic perimeter block.
Rendering engine ready: Blender 5.2 LTS (bpy, Cycles CPU). Excluded per client instruction: 3 results files (stage I/II results, admission list).
